notes.title: Minor update....
notes.content:
-Added more achievements.

-Added Japanese localization(still incomplete and a work in progress)

-Added extra cutscenes depending on the route you're on at the end of the demo(Avoid the neutral route for now, you might be softlocked.)

-Bug fixes made to the Pixl Mode battles, particularly at the Fatality pop up.

-Fixed the first infected Pixl mode battle. Fighting the enemy is less of a grind now.

-Added a pop-up anytime an achievement was earned in-game.

That is all, final ending cutscene will be added later today before focus would be directed towards localizing the game as well as its store page.

Thanks for playing! :D

notes.title: Playtest Build for next FINAL Demo Update out now
notes.content:
Had to add a quick path due to a huge soft locking bug a while back, sorry.

Anyways, there's more stuff to do in here now along with another pixl mode enemy to heal/kill as you please.

There is also a new achievement set up. This is our first time adding this sort of thing, so we want to make sure it really works before making it public by February.

Anyways, thanks for taking the time to playtest The InBetween. And we hope you enjoy the game long enough to beat the demo.

One more thing, a challenge.

I challenge you to beat the demo at a faster time. The current record is 64 minutes, by yours truly.😏

Thanks for playing! ^-^
